# harvester_kubeovn_ip (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# kube-ovn names the IP of a VM <vm name>.<vm namespace> on the default
# network, and <vm name>.<vm namespace>.<network name>.<network namespace>.ovn
# on an overlay network.
data "harvester_kubeovn_ip" "example" {
  name = "my-vm.default.my-overlay-network.default.ovn"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Any text you want that better describes this resource
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) Allocated address, both families separated by a comma on a dual-stack subnet.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the port.
- `message` (String)
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the pod.
- `node_name` (String) Node the pod runs on.
- `pod_name` (String) Name of the pod (virt-launcher pod for a VM) the address belongs to.
- `state` (String)
- `subnet` (String) Subnet the address is allocated from.
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `v4_ip` (String) IPv4 address.
- `v6_ip` (String) IPv6 address.
